Appeal is admitted for final hearing.

Heard on I.A.No.16124/2025, which is first application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C for
suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant- Santosh Malviya.

The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 21.04.2025 passed by the learned Fifteenth Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Bhopal (M.P.) in SC No.238/2023, whereby appellant has convicted and sentenced under Section 3/4(2) of POCSO Act and Section 376(3) of IPC and R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.100/- with default stipulations.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that appellant is innocent.

entities.text: Fifteenth Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Bhopal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: There are general and omnibus allegations against the appellant.
DNA report qua present appellant Santosh Malviya is negative and it is positive for Durgesh Bhatia.
Though it is mentioned that victim was in the company of Santosh and at later point of time the DNA qua Durgesh Bhatia was found positive.
There are good chances of success in appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.
Shri S.K. Shrivastava, learned counsel for State opposed the prayer for 2 CRA-5263-2025 suspension of sentence.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the fact that there appears to be good chances of success in appeal, without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of jail sentence of appellant- Santosh Malviya and release him on bail.

List for final hearing in due course.
